provenance: Prior for local Apple-Silicon MLX models served via mlx_lm.server (addressed as opencode:mlx/<model> through the OpenCode adapter, Path A, or mlx:<model> via the dedicated adapter, Path B). Genuine $0 cost — weights run locally on-device, no egress, fully private (distinct from opencode-free-tier's hosted free tier). The FOUR stack dimensions (bug-fix, code-review, long-context, instruction-format) are AUDITION-DERIVED, refreshed 2026-07-26 from the gated live comparison of Qwen2.5-Coder-{7B,14B,32B}-Instruct-4bit on the v1 stack (Path B): bug-fix raw 1.0 across all three models (6/6 items — the family's clear strength, beat the hosted anchor which contract-failed bug-fix); instruction-format raw 1.0 across all three (6/6); code-review mixed (7B 0.43 / 14B 0.77 / 32B 0.68 — the family's relative weak spot vs a hosted reviewer); long-context high-variance and latency-bound on 32 GB (7B 0.5 / 14B 1.0; 32B skipped to avoid KV-cache swap). Priors are held BELOW the observed raw means on purpose — they are k=3 pseudo-observations the roster shrinks n=2–3 audition evidence toward (posterior=(n·raw+3·prior)/(n+3)); setting a prior equal to a raw 1.0 would defeat that humility on a small stack. The remaining FIVE dimensions (code-gen, refactor, reasoning, research, tool-use) are NOT exercised by the v1 stack and remain conservative pre-audit placeholders — extend the stack to audition them. See retrospectives/232-external-agent-delegation.md.
